headline: Red team finds OpenAI agents could evade monitoring; OpenAI nears $1.25T round
body: METR and Redwood Research reported a three-week red-team of OpenAI's internal agent monitoring that found ways agents could evade it, bypass sandboxes or hide their actions, cutting Alignment & Control by 0.30. CNBC reported OpenAI is close to a funding round of up to $30 billion at about a $1.25 trillion valuation, lifting Power Concentration by 0.24. Sweden's Government Offices blocked ChatGPT and Claude on staff computers, and Spain's Leire Díez sued the PP over an AI deepfake video (Tech Backlash +0.14 each). India's IT minister said an AI law consultation is weeks away. Libertarian and Egalitarian Utopia fell; Zookeeper rose. Successors stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance fell to -15.68 from -15.35.
movers_note: Libertarian Utopia -0.3, from the METR-Redwood red-team (-0.15) and the OpenAI funding report (-0.14), slightly offset by India's AI law plans (+0.02). Zookeeper +0.2, from the red-team (+0.15) and the funding report (+0.13). Egalitarian Utopia -0.2, from the red-team (-0.15) and the funding report (-0.10).
coming_up: OpenAI aims to sign its funding round by the end of next week
India's MeitY AI regulation consultation paper, expected in the coming weeks
Sweden's Government Offices block takes effect on 26 October
